_readme: Hand-written overrides for the Instagram feed. scripts/sync-facebook.mjs reads
this file and merges it into assets/data/news.json on every run, so anything
here survives the sync — use it for English / Japanese copy, custom titles,
and curated posts that are not social posts at all.
Key = the post id (visible in assets/data/news.json). Instagram posts carry
an "ig-" prefix; curated posts use whatever id you give them.
Add title_en / title_ja / message_en / message_ja / excerpt_en / excerpt_ja
for translations; set "hidden": true to drop a post; set "pinned": true to
keep a post even after it scrolls past the feed limit.
Curated posts (not from Instagram) just need their own id plus title_zh /

manual-2026-10-30-f4a7338a.title_zh: 揀咗『超潤滑』，點解仲係越用越乾？
manual-2026-10-30-f4a7338a.excerpt_zh: 問題唔係出喺潤滑嘅「量」，而係出喺潤滑嘅「成分」。玻尿酸長效鎖水、清爽唔黏膩、溫和親膚；傳統矽油或甘油基底就容易變乾、黏膩、難以清洗。
manual-2026-10-30-f4a7338a.title_en: Why does "ultra smooth" still dry out?
manual-2026-10-30-f4a7338a.excerpt_en: The problem is rarely how much lubricant a condom carries — it is what that lubricant is made of. Hyaluronic acid locks in moisture for longer, stays light and never sticky, and is gentle on sensitive skin. Traditional silicone or glycerin bases dry out, turn tacky and are hard to wash off.
